text:
Priya Patel: Quick sync — Catalyst (SI) is ready to co-sell on the cloud marketplace. Need final lead/account mapping and ROE before we kick the joint announcement. Target announce date: Wed 4/15. Who's owning demo and who handles contract intro?

Evan Zhou: I can own the demo + technical walkthroughs. Can someone confirm which accounts are in scope?

Jo Gomez: Putting a quick mapping below — this is what Catalyst sent over. Please confirm ownership.
```
ACME Corp -> Catalyst (primary), Redwood support + marketplace listing
Bluefin Media -> Redwood (primary for sales), Catalyst for implementation
Northwind Finance -> joint (Catalyst handles compliance + infra)
```

Marcus Lee: For ACME and Bluefin, we should follow the standard SI handoff: 
- Sales lead remains with owner until contract signature
- SI gets technical ownership after SOW sign
- Redwood supports marketplace listing + billing integration

Diego (Catalyst SI): Confirmed on our side for ACME and Northwind. We need Redwood to: 1) add joint listing copy to marketplace page, 2) grant demo env access to Catalyst by EOD Tue.

Priya Patel: @PartnerOps Bot can you create the handoff ticket and add the checklist? Also adding a short ROE snippet so legal/sales are aligned.

PartnerOps Bot: New ticket created: #PO-4721 "Catalyst SI marketplace handoff" — assigned to @Jo Gomez, @Evan Zhou. Checklist template attached.

Jo Gomez: ROE draft (very short):
- Pre-sign: Sales owns client comms
- Post-sign: SI (Catalyst) owns implementation tasks; Redwood handles listing & billing
- Announcements: Joint PR; Redwood drafts listing copy, Catalyst drafts customer quote
- Escalations: @Marcus Lee is escalation owner for marketplace issues

Evan Zhou: Can we add a simple SLA for demo access? Something like: demo access provisioned within 24 hours of request for active accounts.

Diego (Catalyst SI): 24h SLA is fine. We'll prepare a partner quote for the PR by Tue EOD.

Priya Patel: Great. Action items: 
1) @Jo finalize marketplace copy + ticket checklist (PO-4721) — due Tue 12pm PT
2) @Evan prep demo env and the quick slide deck — due Tue 5pm PT
3) @Marcus confirm escalation path with support ops — due Tue EOD
4) @Diego send partner quote and logo assets — due Tue EOD

Jo Gomez: I'll update the ticket now and leave comments for Legal on the ROE.

Marcus Lee: Filing the escalation doc with SRE and support ops. Noted.

Evan Zhou: Starting demo infra provisioning now. Will update PO-4721 when ready.

Priya Patel: Thanks team — will reconvene Wed morning for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
